Container.Name: novacortex-api

Branch.TagDescription: Rolling tag — always the newest published release

Container.Overview:
REST + MCP API for NovaCortex — self-hosted, MCP-native long-term memory for AI agents.
Part 4 of a 5-container stack. The API is stateless: memories and the relation graph live in SurrealDB, vectors in Qdrant, sessions and rate-limit counters in Redis.
Two supported ways to install, both ending up with the same five container names:
-- Path A: the five NovaCortex templates from Community Apps, in this order --
0. Create the shared network once, from an Unraid terminal: docker network create novacortex Container-name DNS only works on a user-defined network, and that is how these containers find each other. 1. novacortex-redis 2. novacortex-surrealdb 3. novacortex-qdrant 4. novacortex-api (this template) 5. novacortex-web
The connection defaults below already point at the other containers by name. Set SURREALDB_PASS to the password you gave novacortex-surrealdb, and put the novacortex-redis password into REDIS_URL.
-- Path B: the whole stack in one click, with the Docker Compose Manager plugin --
1. Install the "Docker Compose Manager" plugin from Community Apps. 2. Add a new project named "novacortex". Compose Manager creates /boot/config/plugins/compose.manager/projects/novacortex/ 3. Put docker-compose.unraid.yml from the repository in that folder as docker-compose.yml: curl -fsSL -o docker-compose.yml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nova-Cognitive-Systems/novacortex/main/docker-compose.unraid.yml 4. Create a .env next to it with scripts/gen-env.sh --unraid, which writes strong random secrets and APPDATA=/mnt/user/appdata/novacortex. Add --local-ai for a fully offline install, then start the stack with the "local-ai" profile. .env.unraid.example documents every value. Keep APPDATA an absolute path on the array. Compose Manager stores its projects on the FAT32 boot flash, which has no Unix ownership, so a relative data root leaves Redis unable to take ownership of its own directory and restart-looping as unhealthy. 5. Check the ports in .env are free before starting. 3000 is a popular default on Unraid (Grafana, Homepage, Overseerr, ...), so it is often already taken. If "ss -ltnp | grep -E ':(3000|3001)'" shows something listening, set e.g. WEB_PORT=3100. 6. Compose Up. Then read the one-time bootstrap code with "docker logs novacortex-api 2>&1 | grep -A1 'Bootstrap code'" and paste it on the login page to mint your admin token.
Default ports: API 3001 (Swagger at /docs), Web UI 3000 — set here in the template on path A, or via API_PORT / WEB_PORT in the .env on path B. Data lives under /mnt/user/appdata/novacortex either way, so it survives docker.img rebuilds and is covered by Unraid appdata backups.
First start prints a one-time bootstrap code to the container log. Exchange it for an admin token on the Web UI login page, or POST it to /setup/bootstrap.
Container.Description:
NovaCortex gives AI agents a persistent, queryable memory that lives on your own hardware. Typed memories (episodic, semantic, procedural, working) with salience and decay, semantic vector search over Qdrant, a typed relation graph, a document knowledge base, and per-agent namespaces. Agents connect over MCP (Claude, Cursor, Claude Code), the REST API, the CLI or the TypeScript/Python SDKs. Memory can be exported and re-imported as portable JSON, MessagePack or AES-256-GCM-encrypted archives, so there is no lock-in.
Embeddings are optional and off by default: without them search falls back to substring matching, and /health reports the active mode so a silent degrade is visible. Point OPENAI_BASE_URL at an Ollama sidecar to keep every byte of memory text on this server, or set OPENAI_API_KEY to use OpenAI. Setting LLM_MODEL additionally turns on the intelligence layer (LLM fact extraction and append-only conflict resolution). Apache-2.0; the free tier needs no key and no account.
Container.Requires: A user-defined Docker network named "novacortex" (docker network create novacortex), plus reachable SurrealDB (v2.2+), Qdrant (v1.14+) and Redis (7+) instances — this template does not install them. The novacortex-surrealdb, novacortex-qdrant and novacortex-redis templates in this repository set them up with matching defaults. API and Web UI must run the same NovaCortex version.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: mcp memory self-hosted agents qdrant surrealdb novacortex ai llm vector semantic knowledge-base

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Host port for the NovaCortex REST API. Swagger UI is served at /docs. Change it if 3001 is already taken — the WebUI link above follows whatever you set here, and the container keeps listening on 3001 internally.

Config.Name: SurrealDB URL
Config.Description: WebSocket RPC endpoint of your SurrealDB instance.

Config.Name: SurrealDB Password
Config.Description: SurrealDB root password. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 24

Config.Name: Qdrant URL
Config.Description: HTTP endpoint of your Qdrant instance.

Config.Name: Redis URL
Config.Description: Redis connection URL including the password, e.g. redis://:yourpassword@novacortex-redis:6379

Config.Name: Qdrant API Key
Config.Description: Only needed if your Qdrant instance requires authentication.

Config.Name: Embeddings API Key
Config.Description: Enables semantic search. Leave empty for substring-only search. Set to any non-empty value (e.g. ollama) when using a local OpenAI-compatible server.

Config.Name: Embeddings Base URL
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for embeddings. Empty = OpenAI. For a local Ollama container use http://ollama:11434/v1 (keeps all memory text on this server).

Config.Name: Embedding Model
Config.Description: Embedding model name. Must match QDRANT_VECTOR_SIZE — nomic-embed-text is 768, text-embedding-3-small is 1536. A mismatch fails startup loudly.

Config.Name: Qdrant Vector Size
Config.Description: Vector dimension of the embedding model. Changing it needs a fresh Qdrant collection.

Config.Name: Intelligence LLM Model
Config.Description: Optional. Enables LLM fact extraction and append-only conflict resolution, e.g. qwen3:8b on a local Ollama or gpt-4o-mini on OpenAI. Empty = off.

Config.Name: CORS Origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of allowed browser origins, e.g. http://SERVER-IP:3000. Empty = permissive.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: One of: debug, info, warn, error.

Config.Name: License Key
Config.Description: Optional Pro/Enterprise key. Empty = free tier (3 namespaces), which needs no key and no account.
